about: E12 Amendment 2: why the re-switching term falls on rand32b's students, and whether students switch their fine-tunes' subcomponents. Plan reports/plans/2026-11-02_plan_e12-amend2-rand32b-fall.md (2026-11-02). experiments/new_vs_existing/amend2.py reads its `config` from this file and refuses to start without it; the training recipe (Adam 1e-5, 1000 steps, batch 32) is read from predictions_amend1.json through amend1.py. The results file stores the commit and this file's sha256.
request_in_the_terms_words: On the two rand32b fine-tunes and the two rand32 fine-tunes, run teacher training again as in E12 Amendment 1 (component training with loss KL(teacher || student), teacher = the fine-tuned model, Gamma and Delta frozen, Adam 1e-5, 1000 steps) and read the student's own state, Delta fixed, from its fp32 weights. Does the fall in the re-switching term L01 - L00 on rand32b survive a second batch order? Are the subcomponents Gamma switches on at the trigger on the student's activations the ones it switches on on the fine-tuned model's? Which change in Gamma's values gives the fall back?

sources_of_lines.s_on_thr: E12's DG_THR and gamma.S_ON_THR: the recruit test's rule, mean trigger value up by more than 0.3 over W0's
sources_of_lines.read_tol: Amendment 1's filed w0_tol; its measured W0 differences across runs on this card were exactly 0
sources_of_lines.repro_tol: about 5 x the largest batch-order change Amendment 1 measured, 0.009 nats (rand32 s0). A same-order retrain perturbs less than a different batch order. rand32b's own batch-order change is unmeasured, which is P1: if this stop fires on rand32b, that is itself the result and goes to the lead
sources_of_lines.zero_tol: Amendment 1's filed zero_tol for two reads of one path on one card; it read exactly 0 there
sources_of_lines.fall_line: half of the smaller rand32b fall in Amendment 1 (1.02 nats)
sources_of_lines.gone_line: the largest change on Amendment 1's six other states is 0.132 nats, rounded up
sources_of_lines.half: a majority of the fall, the plain meaning of 'carries it'. Not measured
sources_of_lines.ladder, few_k, diffuse_k: E12's switched-on sets on the map tables hold 21 to 51 subcomponents, rand32b's 21 and 27. few: at most 10, under half of rand32b's set. diffuse: at least 100, about twice the largest map set
sources_of_lines.J_seed and J_other: measured in this job from the fine-tunes; E12 read J_seed at 0.655 on rand32b and 0.533 on rand32 (E46's rebuilds may differ by a member or two)
sources_of_lines.P5: E12's separation rule (gap over the larger range), the project's standing rule for two groups

measurements.L00, L01: As Amendment 1: mean log-odds of the target at the trigger on 97 held-out windows of E46's windows_<task>.pt, released components, Delta out, masked by Gamma's values at W0 (L00) or at the state (L01). L01 reads the same whatever the target weights, since Delta is out; only the gates carry the state.
measurements.fall: L01(fine-tune's values) - L01(student's values), nats, absolute; positive means the student's re-switching term is smaller. Quantity: masked log-odds. Held fixed: released components, windows, Gamma. Varied: Gamma's values, across all positions of each window.
measurements.switched-on set S: alive subcomponents whose mean trigger value over the 97 windows is up by more than 0.3 over W0's (recruit.trigger_dg, recruit.switched)
measurements.J: Jaccard |A & B| / |A | B| of two switched-on sets (recruit.jaccard); nan when both are empty
measurements.restore: Start from the student's values at every position. Write the fine-tune's values at the trigger position only, on a chosen group of subcomponents. Nats given back = masked log-odds with released components after the write, minus before. at_trigger: every subcomponent. Blocks: dropped = in the fine-tune's S, not the student's; kept = in both; added = in the student's, not the fine-tune's; outside = every other alive subcomponent. These four partition the alive set; they need not sum to at_trigger, as the masked model is not linear in the values, and dead subcomponents are in at_trigger only.
measurements.ladder: The same restore on the k alive subcomponents with the largest mean over windows of |fine-tune's value - student's value| at the trigger, k in config.ladder.
measurements.distance: ||student's change - teacher's change||_F / ||teacher's change||_F over all 24 matrices together, in fp32; student's change is the student's target weights minus W0

states: Order-0 students rand32b s0, rand32 s0, rand32b s1, rand32 s1, in that order, each against Amendment 1's L01. Then order-1 students rand32b s0 and s1. Six students. Names as Amendment 1: <task>_<seed>, order-1 <task>_<seed>_o1. Batches: fine-tunes draw from a generator seeded by their seed, so among rand32b's four students, s0 order 0 and s1 order 1 share their first batches (up to step 30) with their teacher, and s1 order 0 and s0 order 1 do not. P1's two seeds therefore also compare one sharing state with one not, the other way round from order 0.

P1.claim: the fall on rand32b is not a batch-order effect
P1.rule: Absolute nats. Fall of each order-1 student against the same fine-tune. Under 2 states, or any not finite: 'unscorable'. All >= 0.5: 'holds'. All with |fall| <= 0.15: 'gone'. Otherwise 'varies'; a rise above 0.15 nats reads 'varies'. 0.5 is 'holds' and 0.15 is 'gone'. Reported beside: the order-0 falls, and noise_move, |L01(order 0) - L01(order 1)| / the fine-tune's gain, against Amendment 1's 0.0005 and 0.0006 on the other tables.
P1.lean: holds, medium-high: the two seeds agree at 1.02 and 1.22, though they share a batch order (review M1), so that agreement says little
P1.blind_to: more than one extra batch order; whether the fall changes with the windows, the step or the learning rate
P1.positive_control: the control below reproduces the falls at order 0; if it does not, P1 is not read
P1.noise_floor: this reading is the noise floor rand32b lacked

P2.claim: students switch on the same subcomponents as their fine-tunes
P2.rule: J = Jaccard(fine-tune's S, order-0 student's S) on rand32b s0 and s1, absolute. J_seed = Jaccard of the two rand32b fine-tunes' S. J_other = the largest Jaccard between a rand32b fine-tune's S and a rand32 fine-tune's S. Both measured in this job. Under 2 states or any not finite (both sets empty): 'unscorable'. J_other >= J_seed: 'no power'. All J >= J_seed: 'same', since a student is as near its fine-tune as the other seed's fine-tune is. All J <= J_other: 'different', since it is no nearer than a different table. Otherwise 'partly'. Reported as against_reference, separately: gap = min J(rand32 students) - max J(rand32b students); noise = the largest 1 - Jaccard(order-0 student's S, order-1 student's S) on rand32b. gap > noise: 'lower'. min J(rand32b) - max J(rand32) > noise: 'higher'. Otherwise 'no different'. Empty or not finite: 'unscorable'.
P2.lean: partly, low: a 20% fall makes some loss of members likely, but the 0.3 line tolerates lowered values
P2.blind_to: values that fall without crossing the 0.3 line (P3's kept block reads those); subcomponents switched on for a few keys only, whose mean over 97 windows stays under 0.3 (P4's ladder ranks by per-window change and is not blind to these; the outside block holds them); position other than the trigger; on rand32 the teacher holds P(target) at only 0.55-0.59, so the reference differs in teacher quality too, and one member of a set of about 25 moves J by about 0.04
P2.positive_control: J_other reads low (different tables). If it is not below J_seed the rule reads 'no power'. J_seed against E12's 0.655 and 0.533, reported, no stop
P2.noise_floor: 1 - Jaccard between batch orders, measured in this job

P3.claim: which change in Gamma's values gives the fall back
P3.rule: Per rand32b order-0 state, nats over nats, relative to that state's fall. Not finite: 'unscorable'. Fall < 0.5: 'no fall'. at_trigger / fall < 0.5: 'not at the trigger'. Otherwise the block with the strictly largest nats given back, if its share of the fall is >= 0.5: that block's name; a tie or a largest share under 0.5: 'spread'. An empty block gives back 0. Verdict: the label both states read; any state 'unscorable': 'unscorable'; otherwise different labels: 'mixed'. 0.5 meets each line.
P3.lean: kept, low: the term falls by a fifth while the shares of the other tables hold, which reads more like lower values on the same members than lost members
P3.blind_to: the order of restoring, since a block is restored alone from the student's values; values at other positions, except that 'not at the trigger' says they matter; per-window sign, since nats are means
P3.positive_control: restoring every value at every position gives the fine-tune's L01 within 1e-6, a stop on the first student; and on rand32 the same reads are reported in nats beside a fall of under 0.1 nats, unscored
P3.noise_floor: the order-1 students read the same blocks, reported, not scored

P4.claim: whether the fall is about a few subcomponents or many
P4.rule: Per rand32b order-0 state. Not finite: 'unscorable'. Fall < 0.5: 'no fall'. at_trigger / fall < 0.5: 'not at the trigger'. k50 = the smallest k in 1, 3, 10, 30, 100, 300 whose nats given back are >= 0.5 x fall. k50 <= 10: 'few'. k50 = 30: 'middling'. k50 >= 100, or no k reaches it: 'diffuse'. Verdict over the two states as in P3.
P4.lean: diffuse, low: E12 reads mean changes of 0.018-0.019 over alive subcomponents on these tables, and the fall has no sign of a single member
P4.blind_to: effect per unit of value: the ladder ranks by how much a value changed, not by what the change does, so a large effect from a small change comes late and can read 'diffuse' wrongly; a set of few per key over 32 keys reads as many
P4.positive_control: the same ladder from W0's values to the fine-tune's on rand32b, on the term itself (5.8 to 6.0 nats), label reported, no stop. Expected 'few' or 'middling', as the term lives in sets of 21 and 27 by E12's reading, low confidence. If it reads 'diffuse', the ladder is a weak test of concentration here and P4 is reported as such
P4.noise_floor: the order-1 students' ladders, reported, not scored

P5.claim: whether rand32b's students end further from their teachers, relative to teacher size, than rand32's
P5.rule: distance of rand32b s0, s1 against rand32 s0, s1, order 0. Under 2 in a table or any not finite (a zero teacher): 'unscorable'. within = the larger table's range. min(rand32b) - max(rand32) > within: 'further'. min(rand32) - max(rand32b) > within: 'nearer'. Otherwise 'no separation'. Ties at the line read 'no separation'.
P5.lean: no separation, low: the size ratios 0.88 and 1.34 of Amendment 1 are ratios of norms, and say nothing about direction
P5.blind_to: which matrices; where in weight space; much of any distance can be what a student cannot express with Delta fixed, so this bears on 'the student reaches its teacher' only loosely; rand32's teacher is half-learned; two states per table
P5.positive_control: none in this job: 0 for a state against itself, by code
P5.noise_floor: the within-table range, which is in the rule

fall, nats.do-nothing: 0, by code: the fine-tune against itself
fall, nats.order 1: at least 0.5 on rand32b, by the lean

J.control: J_seed about 0.655 on rand32b; J_other under it
J.students: rand32 at least 0.7; rand32b 0.5 to 1, a guess

n_on.control: fine-tunes rand32b 27, 21 and rand32 41, 51, from E12, within a few

nats given back.control: restoring everything everywhere = the fall, within 1e-6
nats given back.at_trigger: rand32b at least 0.5 of the fall, by the lean
nats given back.blocks and ladder: no filed number beyond the verdict lines

distance.do-nothing: 1: its student's change is 0, so the teacher's whole change is the distance
distance.control: not defined; a student against itself would read 0

expected.read_from_the_code: None of the do-nothing or W0 values above runs as a state here: they follow from the code, since gates depend only on the target weights and masked_lo only on the gates.

stop_rules.inputs: No file checks of their own: the do-nothing L01 and W0 cell reads below would miss if a fine-tune or a windows file had changed. Refuses if the results file already exists.
stop_rules.card: Stop unless the card is Amendment 1's (NVIDIA L40): every reference number below is on that card.
stop_rules.stage 0: W0 cells T0, U0, L00 against stage0a.json's within 0.02 (Job.task, as Amendment 1). Each fine-tune's L01 against Amendment 1's do-nothing L01 within 0.02. No training has run.
stop_rules.the control: Order-0 students run first, rand32b s0 then rand32 s0. Each order-0 student's L01 against Amendment 1's within 0.05 nats, else stop. Its L01 by gates against its route split within 1e-6, else stop. Restoring all values at every position on the first student gives the fine-tune's L01 within 1e-6, else stop. No order-1 student runs until all four order-0 students pass.
stop_rules.later students: Order-1 students have no comparison to stop on, since that is P1.

edge_cases_run_before_filing: ~/commute-data/scratch/commute-lead/e12a2-writer/edge.py on amend2.py's rule functions, 2026-11-02, all as expected on the filed text: empty lists, a short list, nan in each rule; P1 exactly at 0.5 and 0.15, a rise, one holds one gone; P2 J = J_seed, J = J_other, J_seed = J_other, both sets empty (nan), gap = noise, a noise of 0, 'higher'; P3 fall exactly 0.5, under it, negative, zero fall, at_trigger share exactly 0.5, a tie, an empty block, largest share exactly 0.5 and under it; P4 each k, no k, a wrong-length ladder, k50 exactly at 0.5; P5 ties at the line, a zero teacher, reversed; agree on empty, mixed, one unscorable.

departures.from_Amendment_1: Six students of ten; rand32b also at batch order 1, which Amendment 1 did not read; reads L01, sets, restores and distance, not the whole table or state (b); no C1; no least-squares read. Results are read from fp32 weights as filed there.
departures.from_E12: The switched-on set is E12's, on E46's rebuilt fine-tunes, on an L40, not an A40.
departures.from_the_filed_clause: Amendment 1's what_changes_next read 'nothing further runs'. The lead departs from it for this anomaly only (reports/reviews/2026-11-02_review_e12-amend1-analysis.md, M5), under the user's standing rule to run anomalies down first.
departures.from_VPD: As Amendment 1: U and V alone on an unmasked KL to a teacher, Gamma and Delta frozen, no sparsity or masked loss. Gamma sees 41-token windows where it trained on rows of 512. The restore writes Gamma's values by hand, which VPD never does.

limits_carried: A new circuit from old pieces reads 'elicited' to VPD, and E50 Amendment 1 did not show W0 performs the copy task, so the classes are 'copy' and 'random map', not 'existing' and 'new'. This run has no copy table.
what_changes_next: Each clause ends with the user hearing the result first. P1 gone: the fall is a batch-order effect; Amendment 1's report says so, and P2 to P5 are reported but carry no cause. P1 varies: the term has large batch-order noise on rand32b; quote it as a range, and nothing further runs. P1 holds and P4 few: name those subcomponents, and reading what they do on W0's text is the one follow-up proposed. P1 holds and P4 middling or diffuse: the fall is recorded as a spread lowering of Gamma's values, the student/teacher size correlation stays a correlation, and nothing further runs. P3 or P4 not at the trigger: the fall lies in values at earlier positions, the sets at the trigger do not speak to it, and restoring by position is the one follow-up proposed. P2 same: 'a student switches on the same subcomponents' may be claimed for these tables, by the switched-on rule. P2 partly or different: the claim is not made, and 'keeps its fine-tune's re-switching' stays about nats only. P2 no power or unscorable: the set reading is not used. P5 further: consistent with the reach reading, and no more than that; P5 no separation or nearer: the reach reading loses its one direct test. No outcome changes Amendment 1's scored verdicts, which stand as filed.
not_run: ident32 and ident32b students, Amendment 1's states (b), its C1 and its least-squares reads
A rank of subcomponents by effect rather than by change of value
Restoring by position other than the trigger; values at the trigger per key
A third batch order; another step, learning rate or teacher step on rand32b; E42's step-1000 teachers
Reloading the bf16 offsets, to measure their rounding: retraining makes it unnecessary here
Any harness of faithfulness on these students; cheap-method comparisons (baseline-lead's)
